outcome: Risk factors for primary postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 318 postnatal mothers (106 cases and 212 controls) in public hospitals of Southern Tigray, Ethiopia
finding: Abnormal third stage of labor, cesarean section, lack of active management of third-stage labor, absence of labor monitoring by partograph, lack of antenatal care, and complications during pregnancy were identified as risk factors for primary postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as a risk factor for primary postpartum hemorrhage.
